verdict.rationale: Godot ships an official command-line interface for editing, running, exporting, importing, and headless/scripted operation (godot-docs-3/12, godot-probe-4, godot-probe-rt-1), which is directly usable for AI-native/agentic automation workflows like CI builds and scripted editor tasks. missing for 10: no llms.txt or machine-readable docs mirror for agent consumption, and no independent hands-on report specifically validating AI-agent use of the CLI beyond the docs and probe.
